```{r}
plot_lines_multi <- function(
  df,
  filters,
  ycol,  # NOW: can be length 1 or >1 (tick mode supports multi)
  labels = list(title = NULL, x = "Tick", y = ycol),
  show_rep = TRUE,
  show_mean = TRUE,
  cols = NULL,          # colors per filter (unchanged meaning)
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  tick_col = "tick",
  lwd_mean = 3,
  lwd_rep  = 1,
  rep_alpha = 0.35,
  xcol = tick_col,
  ltys = NULL           # NEW: line types per ycol (tick mode only)
) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df), length(filters) >= 1, is.character(ycol))

  # xcol default
  if (is.null(xcol)) xcol <- tick_col

  # Only require tick_col if used as x
  if (identical(xcol, tick_col) && !tick_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop("tick column '", tick_col, "' not found.")
  }

  # Validate ycol(s)
  if (!all(ycol %in% names(df))) {
    bad <- ycol[!(ycol %in% names(df))]
    stop("y column(s) not found in df: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Helper: apply one filter list to df (AND across fields; OR within vectors)
  apply_filter <- function(d, f) {
    keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(d))
    for (nm in names(f)) {
      if (!nm %in% names(d)) next
      v <- f[[nm]]
      keep <- keep & (d[[nm]] %in% v)
    }
    d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # Fix labels
  if (is.null(labels$y)) {
    labels$y <- if (length(ycol) == 1) ycol else paste(ycol, collapse = ", ")
  }
  if (is.null(labels$x) ||
      (identical(labels$x, "Tick") && !identical(xcol, tick_col))) {
    labels$x <- xcol
  }

  make_step_line <- function(dat) {
    dat <- dat[order(dat$tick), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(dat) <= 1) return(dat)

    out <- dat[1, , drop = FALSE]

    for (k in 2:nrow(dat)) {
      old_y <- dat$y[k - 1]
      new_y <- dat$y[k]
      new_t <- dat$tick[k]

      if (is.finite(old_y) && is.finite(new_y) && old_y != new_y) {
        # add point at the new generation but with old optimum
        out <- rbind(
          out,
          data.frame(tick = new_t, y = old_y)
        )
      }

      out <- rbind(out, dat[k, , drop = FALSE])
    }

    rownames(out) <- NULL
    out
  }

  plot_tick_mode <- function(df, filters, ycols, labels, show_rep, cols, xlim, ylim,
                             tick_col, lwd_mean, lwd_rep, rep_alpha, ltys) {

    # colors per filter (original meaning)
    if (is.null(cols)) cols <- rep("black", length(filters))
    if (length(cols) < length(filters)) cols <- rep(cols, length.out = length(filters))

    # line types per y column
    if (is.null(ltys)) ltys <- rep(1, length(ycols))
    if (length(ltys) < length(ycols)) ltys <- rep(ltys, length.out = length(ycols))

    all_ticks <- numeric(0)
    all_vals  <- numeric(0)

    summaries <- lapply(seq_along(filters), function(i) {
      f <- filters[[i]]
      d <- apply_filter(df, f)

      d[[tick_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d[[tick_col]]))
      d$rep         <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d$rep))
      for (yc in ycols) d[[yc]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[yc]]))

      keep <- is.finite(d[[tick_col]]) & is.finite(d$rep)
      for (yc in ycols) keep <- keep & is.finite(d[[yc]])
      d <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]

      if (nrow(d) == 0) {
        stop("no rows after filtering with filter ", i, ": ", paste(names(f), f, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
        return(list(
          reps = setNames(vector("list", length(ycols)), ycols),
          mean = setNames(vector("list", length(ycols)), ycols)
        ))
      }

      # split by rep (store per ycol)
      by_rep <- split(d, d$rep)

      reps_by_y <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) {
        lapply(by_rep, function(x) {
          o <- order(x[[tick_col]])
          data.frame(tick = x[[tick_col]][o], y = x[[yc]][o])
        })
      })
      names(reps_by_y) <- ycols

      # mean per tick (per ycol)
      mean_list <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) {
        m <- aggregate(d[[yc]], by = list(tick = d[[tick_col]]), FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
        names(m)[2] <- "y"
        m <- m[order(m$tick), ]
        all_ticks <<- c(all_ticks, m$tick)
        all_vals  <<- c(all_vals,  m$y)
        m
      })
      names(mean_list) <- ycols

      list(reps = reps_by_y, mean = mean_list)
    })

    if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- range(all_ticks, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- range(all_vals,  na.rm = TRUE)

    plot(NA, NA, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
         xlab = labels$x, ylab = labels$y, main = labels$title)

    for (i in seq_along(summaries)) {
      col_i <- cols[i]
      s <- summaries[[i]]

      for (j in seq_along(ycols)) {
        yc <- ycols[j]
        lty_j <- ltys[j]
        if (yc == "optimum") color = "black" else color = col_i

        # replicate points for this y column
        if (show_rep && length(s$reps[[yc]]) && yc != "optimum") {
          col_rep <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(color, alpha.f = rep_alpha),
                              error = function(e) color)
          for (rp in s$reps[[yc]]) {
            if (nrow(rp) > 1) {
              lines(rp$tick, rp$y, col = col_rep, lwd = lwd_rep, pch = 16)
            }
          }
        }

        if (!show_mean) next  # skip mean line if requested
        # mean line for this y column
        m <- s$mean[[yc]]
        if (!is.null(m) && nrow(m) > 1) {

          if (yc == "optimum") {
            m <- make_step_line(m)
          }

          lines(m$tick, m$y, col = color, lwd = lwd_mean, lty = lty_j)
        }
      }
    }

    invisible(NULL)
  }

plot_generic_x_mode <- function(df, filters, ycol_single, labels, show_rep, cols,
                                xlim, ylim, xcol, lwd_mean, rep_alpha) {

  if (is.null(cols)) cols <- rep("black", length(filters))
  if (length(cols) < length(filters)) cols <- rep(cols, length.out = length(filters))

  subsets <- vector("list", length(filters))
  all_x <- numeric(0)
  all_y <- numeric(0)

  for (i in seq_along(filters)) {
    f <- filters[[i]]
    d <- apply_filter(df, f)

    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      subsets[[i]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    d[[xcol]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[xcol]]))
    d[[ycol_single]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[ycol_single]]))
    d <- d[is.finite(d[[xcol]]) & is.finite(d[[ycol_single]]), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      subsets[[i]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    subsets[[i]] <- d
    all_x <- c(all_x, d[[xcol]])
    all_y <- c(all_y, d[[ycol_single]])
  }

  if (!length(all_x) || !length(all_y)) {
    warning("No data to plot after filtering.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- range(all_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- range(all_y, na.rm = TRUE)

  plot(NA, NA,
       xlim = xlim,
       ylim = ylim,
       xlab = labels$x,
       ylab = labels$y,
       main = labels$title)

  for (i in seq_along(subsets)) {
    d <- subsets[[i]]
    if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) next

    col_i <- cols[i]
    col_pts <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(col_i, alpha.f = rep_alpha),
                        error = function(e) col_i)

    x_vals <- sort(unique(d[[xcol]]))

    mean_x <- numeric(0)
    mean_y <- numeric(0)

    for (xv in x_vals) {
      dx <- d[d[[xcol]] == xv, , drop = FALSE]
      y <- dx[[ycol_single]]

      if (show_rep) {
        points(jitter(rep(xv, length(y)), amount = diff(range(all_x))*0.005),
               y,
               col = col_pts,
               pch = 16)
      }

      mu <- mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
      sdv <- sd(y, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (!is.finite(sdv)) sdv <- 0

      arrows(xv, mu - sdv,
             xv, mu + sdv,
             angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.04,
             col = col_i, lwd = max(1, lwd_mean * 0.5))

      points(xv, mu,
             pch = 21,
             bg = col_i,
             col = col_i,
             cex = 1.1)

      mean_x <- c(mean_x, xv)
      mean_y <- c(mean_y, mu)
    }

    if (length(mean_x) >= 2) {
      o <- order(mean_x)
      lines(mean_x[o], mean_y[o], col = col_i, lwd = lwd_mean)
    }
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

  if (identical(xcol, tick_col)) {
    plot_tick_mode(df, filters, ycol, labels, show_rep, cols, xlim, ylim,
                   tick_col, lwd_mean, lwd_rep, rep_alpha, ltys)
  } else {
    # generic x mode: assume one column; if user passed multiple, take first
    plot_generic_x_mode(df, filters, ycol[1], labels, show_rep, cols,
                        xlim, ylim, xcol, lwd_mean, rep_alpha)
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
# aggregate different cycles into replicate lines to reduce noise
plot_lines_multi_agg_cycle <- function(
  df,
  filters,
  ycol,
  labels = list(title = NULL, x = "Tick", y = ycol),
  show_rep = TRUE,
  cols = NULL,
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  tick_col = "tick",
  lwd_mean = 3,
  lwd_rep  = 1,
  rep_alpha = 0.35,
  xcol = tick_col,
  ltys = NULL,

  # new arguments for cycle mode
  use_cycle_rep = FALSE,
  gap_col = "gap",
  cycle_start = NULL,          # default: min tick in filtered data
  cycle_window = NULL,         # e.g. c(0, 19)
  cycle_fun = c("overlay", "stacked_mean")  # currently overlay behavior
) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df), length(filters) >= 1, is.character(ycol))
  cycle_fun <- match.arg(cycle_fun)

  if (is.null(xcol)) xcol <- tick_col

  if (identical(xcol, tick_col) && !tick_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop("tick column '", tick_col, "' not found.")
  }

  if (!all(ycol %in% names(df))) {
    bad <- ycol[!(ycol %in% names(df))]
    stop("y column(s) not found in df: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "))
  }

  if (use_cycle_rep && !gap_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop("gap column '", gap_col, "' not found.")
  }

  apply_filter <- function(d, f) {
    keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(d))
    for (nm in names(f)) {
      if (!nm %in% names(d)) next
      v <- f[[nm]]
      keep <- keep & (d[[nm]] %in% v)
    }
    d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  if (is.null(labels$y)) {
    labels$y <- if (length(ycol) == 1) ycol else paste(ycol, collapse = ", ")
  }

  if (is.null(labels$x) ||
      (identical(labels$x, "Tick") && !identical(xcol, tick_col))) {
    labels$x <- if (use_cycle_rep) "Cycle tick" else xcol
  }

  plot_tick_mode <- function(df, filters, ycols, labels, show_rep, cols, xlim, ylim,
                             tick_col, lwd_mean, lwd_rep, rep_alpha, ltys,
                             use_cycle_rep, gap_col, cycle_start, cycle_window) {

    if (is.null(cols)) cols <- rep("black", length(filters))
    if (length(cols) < length(filters)) cols <- rep(cols, length.out = length(filters))

    if (is.null(ltys)) ltys <- rep(1, length(ycols))
    if (length(ltys) < length(ycols)) ltys <- rep(ltys, length.out = length(ycols))

    all_ticks <- numeric(0)
    all_vals  <- numeric(0)

    summaries <- lapply(seq_along(filters), function(i) {
      f <- filters[[i]]
      d <- apply_filter(df, f)

      d[[tick_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d[[tick_col]]))
      d$rep <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d$rep))
      for (yc in ycols) d[[yc]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[yc]]))

      keep <- is.finite(d[[tick_col]]) & is.finite(d$rep)
      for (yc in ycols) keep <- keep & is.finite(d[[yc]])

      if (use_cycle_rep) {
        d[[gap_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d[[gap_col]]))
        keep <- keep & is.finite(d[[gap_col]]) & d[[gap_col]] > 0
      }

      d <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]

      if (nrow(d) == 0) {
        stop("no rows after filtering with filter ", i, ": ",
             paste(names(f), f, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
      }

      # ---- cycle mode ----
      if (use_cycle_rep) {
        # allow cycle_start to be scalar or NULL
        start0 <- if (is.null(cycle_start)) min(d[[tick_col]], na.rm = TRUE) else cycle_start

        full_period <- 2 * d[[gap_col]]

        d$cycle_idx  <- floor((d[[tick_col]] - start0) / full_period)
        d$cycle_tick <- (d[[tick_col]] - start0) %% full_period

        # drop incomplete pre-start rows if any
        d <- d[d$cycle_idx >= 0, , drop = FALSE]

        # optional window inside each cycle
        if (!is.null(cycle_window)) {
          if (length(cycle_window) != 2) {
            stop("cycle_window must be length 2, e.g. c(0, 19)")
          }
          d <- d[d$cycle_tick >= cycle_window[1] & d$cycle_tick <= cycle_window[2], , drop = FALSE]
        }

        if (nrow(d) == 0) {
          stop("no rows remain after applying cycle_window.")
        }

        # each rep x cycle is treated as one pseudo-replicate
        d$pseudo_rep <- interaction(d$rep, d$cycle_idx, drop = TRUE)

        by_rep <- split(d, d$pseudo_rep)

        reps_by_y <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) {
          lapply(by_rep, function(x) {
            o <- order(x$cycle_tick)
            data.frame(tick = x$cycle_tick[o], y = x[[yc]][o])
          })
        })
        names(reps_by_y) <- ycols

        mean_list <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) {
          m <- aggregate(d[[yc]], by = list(tick = d$cycle_tick), FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
          names(m)[2] <- "y"
          m <- m[order(m$tick), ]
          all_ticks <<- c(all_ticks, m$tick)
          all_vals  <<- c(all_vals,  m$y)
          m
        })
        names(mean_list) <- ycols

      } else {
        # ---- ordinary tick mode ----
        by_rep <- split(d, d$rep)

        reps_by_y <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) {
          lapply(by_rep, function(x) {
            o <- order(x[[tick_col]])
            data.frame(tick = x[[tick_col]][o], y = x[[yc]][o])
          })
        })
        names(reps_by_y) <- ycols

        mean_list <- lapply(ycols, function(yc) {
          m <- aggregate(d[[yc]], by = list(tick = d[[tick_col]]), FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
          names(m)[2] <- "y"
          m <- m[order(m$tick), ]
          all_ticks <<- c(all_ticks, m$tick)
          all_vals  <<- c(all_vals,  m$y)
          m
        })
        names(mean_list) <- ycols
      }

      list(reps = reps_by_y, mean = mean_list)
    })

    if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- range(all_ticks, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- range(all_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

    plot(NA, NA, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
         xlab = labels$x, ylab = labels$y, main = labels$title)

    for (i in seq_along(summaries)) {
      col_i <- cols[i]
      s <- summaries[[i]]

      for (j in seq_along(ycols)) {
        yc <- ycols[j]
        lty_j <- ltys[j]
        color <- if (yc == "optimum") "black" else col_i

        if (show_rep && length(s$reps[[yc]]) && yc != "optimum") {
          col_rep <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(color, alpha.f = rep_alpha),
                              error = function(e) color)
          for (rp in s$reps[[yc]]) {
            if (nrow(rp) > 1) {
              lines(rp$tick, rp$y, col = col_rep, lwd = lwd_rep)
            }
          }
        }

        m <- s$mean[[yc]]
        if (!is.null(m) && nrow(m) > 1) {
          lines(m$tick, m$y, col = color, lwd = lwd_mean, lty = lty_j)
        }
      }
    }

    invisible(NULL)
  }

  if (identical(xcol, tick_col)) {
    plot_tick_mode(
      df, filters, ycol, labels, show_rep, cols, xlim, ylim,
      tick_col, lwd_mean, lwd_rep, rep_alpha, ltys,
      use_cycle_rep, gap_col, cycle_start, cycle_window
    )
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
plot_lines_mean_sd_band <- function(
  df,
  filters,
  mean_col,
  sd_col,
  labels = list(title = NULL, x = "Tick", y = mean_col),
  show_rep = TRUE,
  cols = NULL,
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  tick_col = "tick",
  lwd_mean = 3,
  lwd_rep  = 1,
  rep_alpha = 0.35,
  band_alpha = 0.20,     # NEW: transparency for shaded band
  xcol = tick_col
) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df), length(filters) >= 1,
            is.character(mean_col), length(mean_col) == 1,
            is.character(sd_col),   length(sd_col)   == 1)

  if (!mean_col %in% names(df)) stop("mean_col '", mean_col, "' not found.")
  if (!sd_col   %in% names(df)) stop("sd_col '",   sd_col,   "' not found.")

  if (is.null(xcol)) xcol <- tick_col

  # Only require tick_col if used as x
  if (identical(xcol, tick_col) && !tick_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop("tick column '", tick_col, "' not found.")
  }

  # Colors per filter
  if (is.null(cols)) cols <- rep("black", length(filters))
  if (length(cols) < length(filters)) cols <- rep(cols, length.out = length(filters))

  # Helper: apply one filter list to df (AND across fields; OR within vectors)
  apply_filter <- function(d, f) {
    keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(d))
    for (nm in names(f)) {
      if (!nm %in% names(d)) next
      v <- f[[nm]]
      keep <- keep & (d[[nm]] %in% v)
    }
    d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # Fix labels
  if (is.null(labels$y)) labels$y <- mean_col
  if (is.null(labels$x) ||
      (identical(labels$x, "Tick") && !identical(xcol, tick_col))) {
    labels$x <- xcol
  }

  use_tick_mode <- identical(xcol, tick_col)

  if (use_tick_mode) {
    # ------------------ "tick mode" (aggregate by tick) ------------------
    all_ticks <- numeric(0)
    all_low   <- numeric(0)
    all_high  <- numeric(0)

    summaries <- lapply(seq_along(filters), function(i) {
      f <- filters[[i]]
      d <- apply_filter(df, f)

      d[[tick_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d[[tick_col]]))
      d$rep         <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d$rep))
      d[[mean_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[mean_col]]))
      d[[sd_col]]   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[sd_col]]))

      d <- d[is.finite(d[[tick_col]]) & is.finite(d$rep) &
               is.finite(d[[mean_col]]) & is.finite(d[[sd_col]]),
             , drop = FALSE]

      if (nrow(d) == 0) {
        return(list(reps = list(),
                    sum = data.frame(tick = integer(0),
                                     mean = numeric(0),
                                     sd   = numeric(0),
                                     low  = numeric(0),
                                     high = numeric(0))))
      }

      # split by rep for optional background (mean_col only)
      by_rep <- split(d[, c(tick_col, mean_col)], d$rep)
      by_rep <- lapply(by_rep, function(x) {
        o <- order(x[[tick_col]])
        data.frame(tick = x[[tick_col]][o], y = x[[mean_col]][o])
      })

      # aggregate across reps per tick:
      # mean of means, and mean of sds
      mean_df <- aggregate(d[[mean_col]], by = list(tick = d[[tick_col]]),
                           FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_df   <- aggregate(d[[sd_col]],   by = list(tick = d[[tick_col]]),
                           FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

      names(mean_df)[2] <- "mean"
      names(sd_df)[2]   <- "sd"

      sum_df <- merge(mean_df, sd_df, by = "tick", all = TRUE)
      sum_df <- sum_df[order(sum_df$tick), ]
      sum_df$low  <- sum_df$mean - sum_df$sd
      sum_df$high <- sum_df$mean + sum_df$sd

      all_ticks <<- c(all_ticks, sum_df$tick)
      all_low   <<- c(all_low,   sum_df$low)
      all_high  <<- c(all_high,  sum_df$high)

      list(reps = by_rep, sum = sum_df)
    })

    # set plot region
    if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- range(all_ticks, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- range(c(all_low, all_high), na.rm = TRUE)

    plot(NA, NA, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
         xlab = labels$x, ylab = labels$y, main = labels$title)

    # draw per filter
    for (i in seq_along(summaries)) {
      col_i <- cols[i]
      s <- summaries[[i]]

      # background replicate points (mean only)
      if (show_rep && length(s$reps)) {
        col_rep <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(col_i, alpha.f = rep_alpha),
                            error = function(e) col_i)
        for (rp in s$reps) {
          if (nrow(rp) > 1) {
            points(rp$tick, rp$y, col = col_rep, lwd = lwd_rep, pch = 16)
          }
        }
      }

      # shaded band + mean line
      sum_df <- s$sum
      if (!is.null(sum_df) && nrow(sum_df) > 1) {
        band_col <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(col_i, alpha.f = band_alpha),
                             error = function(e) col_i)

        # polygon for mean ± mean(sd) per tick
        polygon(
          x = c(sum_df$tick, rev(sum_df$tick)),
          y = c(sum_df$low,  rev(sum_df$high)),
          col = band_col,
          border = NA
        )

        # mean line
        lines(sum_df$tick, sum_df$mean, col = col_i, lwd = lwd_mean)
      }
    }

  } else {
    # ------------------ "generic x mode" (single column logic preserved) ------------------
    all_x <- numeric(0)
    all_y <- numeric(0)
    subsets <- vector("list", length(filters))

    for (i in seq_along(filters)) {
      f <- filters[[i]]
      d <- apply_filter(df, f)
      if (nrow(d) == 0) {
        subsets[[i]] <- NULL
        next
      }

      d[[xcol]]     <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[xcol]]))
      d[[mean_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[mean_col]]))
      d[[sd_col]]   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[sd_col]]))

      d <- d[is.finite(d[[xcol]]) & is.finite(d[[mean_col]]) & is.finite(d[[sd_col]]),
             , drop = FALSE]

      if (nrow(d) == 0) {
        subsets[[i]] <- NULL
        next
      }

      subsets[[i]] <- d
      all_x <- c(all_x, d[[xcol]])
      all_y <- c(all_y, d[[mean_col]] - d[[sd_col]], d[[mean_col]] + d[[sd_col]])
    }

    if (!length(all_x) || !length(all_y)) {
      warning("No data to plot after filtering.")
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- range(all_x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- range(all_y, na.rm = TRUE)

    plot(NA, NA, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim,
         xlab = labels$x, ylab = labels$y, main = labels$title)

    for (i in seq_along(subsets)) {
      d <- subsets[[i]]
      if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) next

      col_i <- cols[i]
      col_pts <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(col_i, alpha.f = rep_alpha),
                          error = function(e) col_i)

      x  <- d[[xcol]]
      mu <- d[[mean_col]]
      sd <- d[[sd_col]]

      if (show_rep) points(x, mu, col = col_pts, pch = 16)

      # For generic x mode: shade pointwise band around observed mean values
      o <- order(x)
      x  <- x[o]; mu <- mu[o]; sd <- sd[o]

      band_col <- tryCatch(adjustcolor(col_i, alpha.f = band_alpha),
                           error = function(e) col_i)
      polygon(
        x = c(x, rev(x)),
        y = c(mu - sd, rev(mu + sd)),
        col = band_col,
        border = NA
      )
      lines(x, mu, col = col_i, lwd = lwd_mean)
    }
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

# integer-named value columns
.value_cols_int <- function(df) grep("^[0-9]+$", names(df), value = TRUE)

# compute binned proportions per-rep and their across-rep mean
.binned_props_for_filter <- function(df, filter, generation, breaks) {
  d <- df
  if (!is.null(generation) && "generation" %in% names(d)) {
    # if generation is a range vector of length 2, keep rows in that range; if single value, keep rows equal to it
    if (length(generation) == 2) {
      d <- d[d$generation >= generation[1] & d$generation <= generation[2], , drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      d <- d[d$generation == generation, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  if (length(filter)) {
    for (nm in names(filter)) if (nm %in% names(d)) d <- d[d[[nm]] == filter[[nm]], , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (nrow(d) == 0) stop("No rows after applying generation/filter.")

  vcols <- .value_cols_int(d)
  if (!length(vcols)) stop("No integer-named value columns found.")

  breaks <- sort(as.numeric(breaks))
  x_min <- min(breaks); x_max <- max(breaks)
  mids  <- (breaks[-1] + breaks[-length(breaks)]) / 2

  reps <- sort(unique(d$rep))
  M <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(reps), ncol = length(mids))

  for (i in seq_along(reps)) {
    dr <- d[d$rep == reps[i], , drop = FALSE]
    vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(dr[, vcols, drop = FALSE], use.names = FALSE)))
    vals <- vals[is.finite(vals) & vals >= x_min & vals <= x_max]
    if (!length(vals)) next
    h <- hist(vals, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)
    prop <- h$counts / sum(h$counts)              # proportions (sum to 1 within range)
    M[i, ] <- prop
  }

  list(mid = mids, mat = M, mean_prop = colMeans(M, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# --- main: plot histogram "lines" (across-rep mean), optional per-rep fades --
plot_hist_lines_multi <- function(
  df,
  filters,                           # list of filter lists: list(f1, f2, ...)
  generation,
  breaks,                            # numeric vector of bin edges (shared by all)
  labels = list(title = "Binned distributions", x = "Value", y = "Proportion"),
  cols = NULL,                       # colors per filter
  lwd = 4,
  show_rep = FALSE,                  # faded per-rep lines behind the mean
  rep_alpha = 0.2,
  rep_lwd = 1,
  add = FALSE,                    # add to existing plot?
  ymax = NULL
) {
  k <- length(filters)
  if (is.null(cols)) cols <- grDevices::hcl.colors(k, "Dark 2", rev = FALSE)

  # compute first, plot after (so y-limits fit all)
  series <- vector("list", k)
  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    series[[i]] <- .binned_props_for_filter(df, filters[[i]], generation, breaks)
  }

  mids <- series[[1]]$mid
  if(is.null(ymax)){
    ymax <- max(vapply(series, function(s) max(s$mean_prop, na.rm = TRUE), 0), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(ymax) || ymax <= 0) ymax <- 1
  }
  if (!add) {
    plot(mids, series[[1]]$mean_prop, type = "n",
         xlab = labels$x, ylab = labels$y, main = labels$title,
         xlim = range(mids), ylim = c(0, 1.05 * ymax))
  }

  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    si <- series[[i]]
    if (isTRUE(show_rep)) {
      rep_col <- grDevices::adjustcolor(cols[i], rep_alpha)
      for (r in seq_len(nrow(si$mat))) {
        yi <- si$mat[r, ]
        if (all(!is.finite(yi))) next
        lines(mids, yi, col = rep_col, lwd = rep_lwd)
      }
    }
    lines(mids, si$mean_prop, col = cols[i], lwd = lwd)
  }

  invisible(series)
}
```

```{r}
# integer-named value columns
.value_cols_int <- function(df) grep("^[0-9]+$", names(df), value = TRUE)

# compute binned proportions per-rep and their across-rep mean
.binned_props_for_filter <- function(df, filter, generation, breaks) {
  d <- df

  if (!is.null(generation) && "generation" %in% names(d)) {
    # if generation is a range vector of length 2, keep rows in that range;
    # if single value, keep rows equal to it
    if (length(generation) == 2) {
      d <- d[d$generation >= generation[1] & d$generation <= generation[2], , drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      d <- d[d$generation == generation, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }

  if (length(filter)) {
    for (nm in names(filter)) {
      if (nm %in% names(d)) {
        d <- d[d[[nm]] == filter[[nm]], , drop = FALSE]
      }
    }
  }

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    stop("No rows after applying generation/filter.")
  }

  vcols <- .value_cols_int(d)
  if (!length(vcols)) stop("No integer-named value columns found.")

  breaks <- sort(as.numeric(breaks))
  x_min <- min(breaks)
  x_max <- max(breaks)
  mids  <- (breaks[-1] + breaks[-length(breaks)]) / 2

  reps <- sort(unique(d$rep))
  M <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(reps), ncol = length(mids))

  for (i in seq_along(reps)) {
    dr <- d[d$rep == reps[i], , drop = FALSE]

    vals <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(unlist(dr[, vcols, drop = FALSE], use.names = FALSE))
    )

    vals <- vals[is.finite(vals) & vals >= x_min & vals <= x_max]

    if (!length(vals)) next

    h <- hist(
      vals,
      breaks = breaks,
      plot = FALSE,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )

    prop <- h$counts / sum(h$counts)
    M[i, ] <- prop
  }

  list(
    mid = mids,
    mat = M,
    mean_prop = colMeans(M, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

plot_hist_lines_multi_gen <- function(
  df,
  filters,                           # list of filter lists: list(f1, f2, ...)
  generation = NULL,                 # single generation or range; kept for old behavior
  generations = NULL,                # NEW: list/vector of generations to plot separately
  breaks,                            # numeric vector of bin edges
  labels = list(title = "Binned distributions", x = "Value", y = "Proportion"),
  cols = NULL,                       # colors per filter
  lwd = 4,
  show_rep = FALSE,                  # faded per-rep lines behind each generation
  show_generation = TRUE,            # NEW: faded generation-level lines
  generation_alpha = 0.25,           # NEW: transparency for generation lines
  generation_lwd = 1.5,              # NEW: line width for generation lines
  rep_alpha = 0.1,
  rep_lwd = 1,
  add = FALSE,
  ymax = NULL,
  plot_mean = TRUE                   # solid line = mean across generations
) {
  k <- length(filters)

  if (length(cols) < k) {
    cols <- rep(cols, length.out = k)
  }

  # Backward compatible behavior:
  # if generations is not given, use generation
  if (is.null(generations)) {
    generations <- list(generation)
  } else {
    # allow generations = c(9999, 10000, 10001)
    # or generations = list(9999, 10000, c(10000, 10100))
    if (!is.list(generations)) {
      generations <- as.list(generations)
    }
  }

  ng <- length(generations)

  # series[[filter_i]][[generation_j]]
  series <- vector("list", k)

  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    series[[i]] <- vector("list", ng)

    for (g in seq_len(ng)) {
      series[[i]][[g]] <- .binned_props_for_filter(
        df = df,
        filter = filters[[i]],
        generation = generations[[g]],
        breaks = breaks
      )
    }
  }

  mids <- series[[1]][[1]]$mid

  # y-limit across all generation-level mean distributions
  if (is.null(ymax)) {
    ymax <- max(
      unlist(
        lapply(series, function(x) {
          lapply(x, function(s) max(s$mean_prop, na.rm = TRUE))
        })
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    if (!is.finite(ymax) || ymax <= 0) ymax <- 1
  }

  if (!add) {
    plot(
      mids,
      series[[1]][[1]]$mean_prop,
      type = "n",
      xlab = labels$x,
      ylab = labels$y,
      main = labels$title,
      xlim = range(mids),
      ylim = c(0, 1.05 * ymax)
    )
  }

  for (i in seq_len(k)) {
    gen_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ng, ncol = length(mids))

    for (g in seq_len(ng)) {
      si <- series[[i]][[g]]
      gen_mat[g, ] <- si$mean_prop

      # faded per-rep lines within each generation
      if (isTRUE(show_rep)) {
        rep_col <- adjustcolor(cols[i], rep_alpha)

        for (r in seq_len(nrow(si$mat))) {
          yi <- si$mat[r, ]
          if (all(!is.finite(yi))) next
          lines(mids, yi, col = rep_col, lwd = rep_lwd)
        }
      }

      # faded generation-level distribution line
      if (isTRUE(show_generation)) {
        alpha_vals <- seq(generation_alpha[1], generation_alpha[2], length.out = ng)
        gen_col <- adjustcolor(cols[i], alpha.f = alpha_vals[g])
        lines(mids, si$mean_prop, col = gen_col, lwd = generation_lwd)
      }
    }

    # solid line = mean distribution across the selected generations
    if (isTRUE(plot_mean)) {
      mean_across_generations <- colMeans(gen_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
      lines(mids, mean_across_generations, col = cols[i], lwd = lwd)
    }
  }

  invisible(series)
}
```

```{r}
plot_asd_div_heatmap <- function(
  fluc_data_df,
  generations = NULL,
  generation_col = NULL,
  rep_col = "rep",
  psis = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  regs = c("ave", "fit", "ext"),
  reg_labels = c(
    ave = "Copy-the-average",
    fit = "Copy-the-best",
    ext = "Copy-the-extreme"
  ),
  value_col = "a_sd",
  file = NULL,
  xlab = "Shift size",
  ylab = "Gap",
  colorbar_label = expression("Mean relative change in " * a[sd] * ": " * psi * "=x / " * psi * "=0 - 1"),
  palette_fun = function(n) colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(n),
  zlim = NULL,
  add_text = TRUE,
  text_digits = 2,
  clip_negative = TRUE,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,

  # CI / significance options
  add_sig = TRUE,
  ci_level = 0.95,
  nboot = 5000,
  seed = NULL,

  # new option
  plot_nonsig_tiles = TRUE
) {

  needed <- c("reg", "psi", "shift_size", "gap", rep_col, value_col)
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(fluc_data_df))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  }

  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  d <- fluc_data_df

  if (is.null(generation_col)) {
    if ("generation" %in% names(d)) {
      generation_col <- "generation"
    } else if ("tick" %in% names(d)) {
      generation_col <- "tick"
    }
  }

  # filter generations
  if (!is.null(generations)) {
    if (is.null(generation_col) || !generation_col %in% names(d)) {
      stop("You supplied generations, but no valid generation_col was found.")
    }

    if (length(generations) == 2) {
      d <- d[
        d[[generation_col]] >= min(generations) &
          d[[generation_col]] <= max(generations),
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    } else {
      d <- d[d[[generation_col]] %in% generations, , drop = FALSE]
    }

    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      stop("No rows left after filtering for generations.")
    }
  }

  d <- d[d$reg %in% regs & d$psi %in% c(0, psis), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    stop("No rows left after filtering regs and psis.")
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 1: average across selected generations within each rep
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  rep_mean_df <- aggregate(
    d[[value_col]],
    by = list(
      reg = d$reg,
      psi = d$psi,
      shift_size = d$shift_size,
      gap = d$gap,
      rep = d[[rep_col]]
    ),
    FUN = mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  names(rep_mean_df)[names(rep_mean_df) == "x"] <- "rep_mean_value"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 2: pair psi=x and psi=0 within the same rep
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  base_rep_df <- rep_mean_df[
    rep_mean_df$psi == 0,
    c("reg", "shift_size", "gap", "rep", "rep_mean_value")
  ]

  names(base_rep_df)[names(base_rep_df) == "rep_mean_value"] <- "base_value"

  nonzero_rep_df <- rep_mean_df[
    rep_mean_df$psi %in% psis & rep_mean_df$reg %in% regs,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  paired_df <- merge(
    nonzero_rep_df,
    base_rep_df,
    by = c("reg", "shift_size", "gap", "rep"),
    all = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(paired_df) == 0) {
    stop("No paired psi=x and psi=0 replicate data found.")
  }

  paired_df$rel_diff <- paired_df$rep_mean_value / paired_df$base_value - 1
  paired_df$rel_diff[!is.finite(paired_df$rel_diff)] <- NA_real_

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step 3: bootstrap CI across replicate-level relative differences
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  boot_ci <- function(x, conf = 0.95, nboot = 5000) {
    x <- x[is.finite(x)]

    if (length(x) == 0) {
      return(c(mean = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_, n_reps = 0))
    }

    x_mean <- mean(x)

    if (length(x) == 1) {
      return(c(mean = x_mean, lower = NA_real_, upper = NA_real_, n_reps = 1))
    }

    boots <- replicate(
      nboot,
      mean(sample(x, size = length(x), replace = TRUE))
    )

    alpha <- 1 - conf

    ci <- quantile(
      boots,
      probs = c(alpha / 2, 1 - alpha / 2),
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    )

    c(
      mean = x_mean,
      lower = ci[1],
      upper = ci[2],
      n_reps = length(x)
    )
  }

  split_key <- interaction(
    paired_df$reg,
    paired_df$psi,
    paired_df$shift_size,
    paired_df$gap,
    drop = TRUE
  )

  summary_list <- lapply(
    split(paired_df, split_key),
    function(x) {
      ci <- boot_ci(
        x$rel_diff,
        conf = ci_level,
        nboot = nboot
      )

      data.frame(
        reg = x$reg[1],
        psi = x$psi[1],
        shift_size = x$shift_size[1],
        gap = x$gap[1],
        mean_rel_diff = ci["mean"],
        ci_lower = ci["lower"],
        ci_upper = ci["upper"],
        n_reps = ci["n_reps"],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  plot_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_list)

  plot_df$sig <- with(
    plot_df,
    is.finite(ci_lower) &
      is.finite(ci_upper) &
      (ci_lower > 0 | ci_upper < 0)
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Color value
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  if (clip_negative) {
    plot_df$color_value <- pmax(plot_df$mean_rel_diff, 0)
  } else {
    plot_df$color_value <- plot_df$mean_rel_diff
  }

  # if requested, non-significant tiles are not plotted at all
  if (!plot_nonsig_tiles) {
    plot_df$color_value[!plot_df$sig] <- NA_real_
  }

  shift_sizes <- sort(unique(plot_df$shift_size))
  gaps <- sort(unique(plot_df$gap))

  # shared color scale across all pages
  if (is.null(zlim)) {
    if (clip_negative) {
      zmax <- max(plot_df$color_value, na.rm = TRUE)

      if (!is.finite(zmax)) {
        zmax <- 1
        warning("No finite values available for color scale; using zlim = c(0, 1).")
      }

      zlim <- c(0, zmax)
    } else {
      max_abs <- max(abs(plot_df$color_value), na.rm = TRUE)

      if (!is.finite(max_abs)) {
        max_abs <- 1
        warning("No finite values available for color scale; using zlim = c(-1, 1).")
      }

      zlim <- c(-max_abs, max_abs)
    }
  }

  if (clip_negative) {
    cols <- palette_fun(100)
  } else {
    cols <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
  }

  n_col <- length(cols)

  if (!is.null(file)) {
    pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
    on.exit(dev.off())
  }

  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # One heatmap per page: psi × reg
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  for (psi_i in psis) {
    for (reg_i in regs) {

      sub <- plot_df[
        plot_df$psi == psi_i &
          plot_df$reg == reg_i,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      if (nrow(sub) == 0) next

      zmat <- matrix(
        NA_real_,
        nrow = length(shift_sizes),
        ncol = length(gaps),
        dimnames = list(
          as.character(shift_sizes),
          as.character(gaps)
        )
      )

      text_mat <- matrix(
        NA_real_,
        nrow = length(shift_sizes),
        ncol = length(gaps),
        dimnames = list(
          as.character(shift_sizes),
          as.character(gaps)
        )
      )

      sig_mat <- matrix(
        FALSE,
        nrow = length(shift_sizes),
        ncol = length(gaps),
        dimnames = list(
          as.character(shift_sizes),
          as.character(gaps)
        )
      )

      for (k in seq_len(nrow(sub))) {
        shift_k <- as.character(sub$shift_size[k])
        gap_k <- as.character(sub$gap[k])

        zmat[shift_k, gap_k] <- sub$color_value[k]
        sig_mat[shift_k, gap_k] <- isTRUE(sub$sig[k])

        # only add text if tile is being plotted
        if (plot_nonsig_tiles || isTRUE(sub$sig[k])) {
          text_mat[shift_k, gap_k] <- sub$mean_rel_diff[k]
        }
      }

      # Layout: heatmap + vertical color bar
      layout(
        matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1),
        widths = c(1, 0.12)
      )

      par(mar = c(4.2, 4.5, 4, 1))

      image(
        x = seq_along(shift_sizes),
        y = seq_along(gaps),
        z = zmat,
        col = cols,
        zlim = zlim,
        xaxt = "n",
        yaxt = "n",
        xlab = xlab,
        ylab = ylab,
        main = bquote(
          .(ifelse(reg_i %in% names(reg_labels), reg_labels[[reg_i]], reg_i)) *
            "," ~ psi == .(psi_i)
        )
      )

      axis(
        side = 1,
        at = seq_along(shift_sizes),
        labels = shift_sizes
      )

      axis(
        side = 2,
        at = seq_along(gaps),
        labels = 2 * gaps,
        las = 1
      )

      box()

      if (add_text) {
        for (ii in seq_along(shift_sizes)) {
          for (jj in seq_along(gaps)) {
            val <- text_mat[ii, jj]

            if (!is.na(val)) {
              text(
                x = ii,
                y = jj,
                labels = round(val, text_digits),
                cex = 0.75
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }

      # vertical color bar
      par(mar = c(4.2, 1, 4, 4))

      z_seq <- seq(zlim[1], zlim[2], length.out = n_col)

      image(
        x = 1,
        y = z_seq,
        z = matrix(z_seq, nrow = 1),
        col = cols,
        zlim = zlim,
        xaxt = "n",
        yaxt = "n",
        xlab = "",
        ylab = ""
      )

      axis(4, las = 1)
      mtext(colorbar_label, side = 4, line = 2.5)
    }
  }

  invisible(list(
    plot_df = plot_df,
    paired_df = paired_df,
    rep_mean_df = rep_mean_df
  ))
}
```


```{r}
# integer-named value columns
.value_cols_int <- function(df) {
  grep("^[0-9]+$", names(df), value = TRUE)
}

# filter dataframe by named parameter list
.filter_df <- function(df, filter = list()) {
  d <- df

  if (length(filter) > 0) {
    for (nm in names(filter)) {
      if (!nm %in% names(d)) {
        warning("Filter column not found and ignored: ", nm)
        next
      }

      d <- d[d[[nm]] %in% filter[[nm]], , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    stop("No rows left after applying filter.")
  }

  d
}

# convert wide replicate/individual columns into long generation-value data
.to_long_generation_value <- function(df, filter = list(), generation = NULL) {
  d <- .filter_df(df, filter)

  if (!is.null(generation)) {
    if (!"generation" %in% names(d)) {
      stop("Column 'generation' not found.")
    }
    d <- d[d$generation %in% generation, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    stop("No rows left after applying generation filter.")
  }

  vcols <- .value_cols_int(d)
  if (length(vcols) == 0) {
    stop("No integer-named value columns found.")
  }

  # IMPORTANT:
  # as.numeric(matrix) reads column-wise in R.
  # We transpose first so values are taken row-wise:
  # row 1 all individuals, row 2 all individuals, etc.
  value_mat <- as.matrix(d[, vcols, drop = FALSE])

  out <- data.frame(
    generation = rep(d$generation, each = length(vcols)),
    value = as.numeric(t(value_mat))
  )

  out <- out[is.finite(out$value), , drop = FALSE]
  out
}

make_colorbar_pdf <- function(
  file = "grey_colorbar.pdf",
  zlim = c(0, 0.08),
  width = 1.6,
  height = 4,
  n_col = 64,
  label = "Density",
  zero_col = "black",
  color_palette = NULL
) {
  if (!is.null(color_palette)) {
    grey_pal <- color_palette
  } else {  
    # grayscale palette for nonzero values
    grey_pal <- gray.colors(n_col, start = 0.95, end = 0.15)
  }
  # include black as the zero color, matching your heatmap logic
  if (!is.null(zero_col)) {
    pal <- c(zero_col, grey_pal)
  }else {
    pal <- grey_pal
  }

  zero_eps <- 1e-6

  # values for color bar
  z_vals <- seq(zlim[1], zlim[2], length.out = n_col)

  # add one artificial zero bin below zlim[1]
  z_plot <- matrix(c(zlim[1] - zero_eps, z_vals), nrow = 1)

  pdf(file, width = width, height = height)

  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit({
    par(old_par)
    dev.off()
  })

  par(mar = c(3, 2, 2, 4))

  image(
    x = 1,
    y = c(zlim[1] - zero_eps, z_vals),
    z = z_plot,
    col = pal,
    zlim = c(zlim[1] - zero_eps, zlim[2]),
    axes = FALSE,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = ""
  )

  axis(
    side = 4,
    at = pretty(zlim),
    labels = pretty(zlim),
    las = 1
  )

  mtext(label, side = 4, line = 2.5)

  box()
}
gen_heatmap <- function(df, breaks, col = "purple",
                        xlab = "Generation", ylab = "Trait value",
                        zlim = c(0, 1),
                        zero_col = "black",
                        zero_eps = 1e-6,
                        x_label_gens = NULL,
                        x_label_text = NULL,
                        color_palette = NULL,
                        line_vals = NULL,
                        gen_vals = NULL,
                        show_mean_line = FALSE) {
  # Build palette
  base_pal <- if (!is.null(color_palette)) {
    color_palette
  } else if (col == "purple") {
    rev(colorRampPalette(c("#EEEDFE", "#AFA9EC", "#7F77DD", "#3C3489"))(64))
  } else if (col == "teal") {
    rev(colorRampPalette(c("#E1F5EE", "#5DCAA5", "#1D9E75", "#085041"))(64))
  } else {
    colorRampPalette(c("white", col))(64)
  }

  if (!is.null(zero_col)) {
    pal <- c(zero_col, base_pal)
  }else {
    pal <- base_pal
  }

  gens <- sort(unique(df$generation))

  lo <- min(breaks)
  hi <- max(breaks)

  df <- df[df$value >= lo & df$value <= hi, , drop = FALSE]

  mids <- (breaks[-1] + breaks[-length(breaks)]) / 2

  mat <- sapply(gens, function(g) {
    vals <- df$value[df$generation == g]
    vals <- vals[vals >= lo & vals <= hi]

    h <- hist(vals, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
    h$density
  })

  mat_plot <- mat
  mat_plot[mat_plot == 0] <- zlim[1] - zero_eps

  image(
    x = seq_along(gens),
    y = mids,
    z = t(mat_plot),
    col = pal,
    zlim = c(zlim[1] - zero_eps, zlim[2]),
    axes = FALSE,
    xlab = xlab,
    ylab = ylab
  )

  # Only label selected generations
  if (is.null(x_label_gens)) {
    x_at <- seq_along(gens)
    x_labs <- gens
  } else {
    keep <- gens %in% x_label_gens
    x_at <- which(keep)
    if (is.null(x_label_text)) {
      x_labs <- gens[keep]
    } else {
      if (length(x_label_text) != length(x_label_gens)) {
        stop("x_label_text must have the same length as x_label_gens.")
      }

      # Keep labels only for generations that are actually present in gens
      x_labs <- x_label_text[x_label_gens %in% gens]
    }
  }

  axis(
    1,
    at = x_at,
    labels = x_labs,
    tick = FALSE
  )

  axis(2, las = 1, tick = FALSE)
  box()

  # Add line on top of heatmap
  if (!is.null(line_vals)) {
    if (length(line_vals) != length(gen_vals)) {
      stop("line_vals must have the same length as the number of generations.")
    }

    line_x <- match(gen_vals, gens)
    line_y <- line_vals

    # # Drop generations not present in the heatmap
    ok <- !is.na(line_x)

    line_x <- line_x[ok]
    line_y <- line_y[ok]

    line_x <- c(min(line_x) - 1, line_x, max(line_x) + 1)
    line_y <- c(head(line_y, 1), line_y, tail(line_y, 1))
    # line_x <- line_x - 0.5

    lines(
      x = line_x,
      y = line_y,
      type = "s",
      col = "blue",
      lwd = 2,
      lty = 1
    )
  }

  # Add mean trait value line for each generation
  if (show_mean_line) {
    mean_vals <- sapply(gens, function(g) {
      vals <- df$value[df$generation == g]
      vals <- vals[vals >= lo & vals <= hi]
      mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    })

    mean_x <- seq_along(gens)

    lines(
      x = mean_x,
      y = mean_vals,
      type = "l",
      col = "red",
      lwd = 2,
      lty = 1
    )
  }
}
plot_pheno_geno_heatmaps <- function(
  cons_pheno_df,
  cons_geno_df,
  breaks,
  pheno_filter = list(),
  geno_filter = list(),
  pheno_generations = NULL,
  geno_generations = NULL,
  file = "heatmap_generations.pdf",
  width = 4,
  height = 8,
  zlim = c(0, 1),
  pheno_zlim = zlim,
  geno_zlim = zlim,
  x_label_gens = c(10000, 10100, 10200, 10300),
  x_label_text = NULL,
  color_palette = NULL,
  zero_col = "black",
  geno_color_palette = NULL,
  pheno_color_palette = NULL,
  line_vals = NULL,
  gen_vals = NULL,
  show_mean_line = FALSE
) {
  pheno_long <- .to_long_generation_value(
    cons_pheno_df,
    filter = pheno_filter,
    generation = pheno_generations
  )

  geno_long <- .to_long_generation_value(
    cons_geno_df,
    filter = geno_filter,
    generation = geno_generations
  )

  pdf(file, width = width, height = height)

  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit({
    par(old_par)
    dev.off()
  })

  par(mfrow = c(2,1), mar = c(3, 3, 2, 1), mgp = c(2, 0.5, 0))

  if (!is.null(color_palette)) {
    pheno_color_palette <- color_palette
    geno_color_palette <- color_palette
  }

  if (!is.null(zlim)) {
    pheno_zlim <- zlim
    geno_zlim <- zlim
  }
  gen_heatmap(pheno_long, breaks, col = "purple", zlim = pheno_zlim, zero_col = zero_col, x_label_gens = x_label_gens, x_label_text = x_label_text, color_palette = pheno_color_palette, line_vals = line_vals, gen_vals = gen_vals, show_mean_line = show_mean_line)
  title(main = "Phenotype", cex.main = 0.95, font.main = 1)

  gen_heatmap(geno_long, breaks, col = "teal", zlim = geno_zlim, zero_col = zero_col, x_label_gens = x_label_gens, x_label_text = x_label_text, color_palette = geno_color_palette, line_vals = line_vals, gen_vals = gen_vals, show_mean_line = show_mean_line)
  title(main = "Genotype", cex.main = 0.95, font.main = 1)

  invisible(list(
    pheno_long = pheno_long,
    geno_long = geno_long
  ))
}
```

```{r}
plot_asd_fluc_minus_cons_heatmap <- function(
  fluc_data_df,
  cons_data_df,
  generations = NULL,
  cons_generations = NULL,
  generation_col = "tick",
  cons_generation_col = "tick",
  rep_col = "rep",
  psis = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  regs = c("ave", "fit", "ext"),
  reg_labels = c(
    ave = "Copy-the-average",
    fit = "Copy-the-best",
    ext = "Copy-the-extreme"
  ),
  value_col = "a_sd",
  file = NULL,
  xlab = "Shift size",
  ylab = "Gap",
  colorbar_label = expression("Mean " * a[sd] * " difference: fluctuating - constant"),
  zlim = NULL,
  add_text = TRUE,
  text_digits = 2,
  clip_negative = FALSE,
  width = 14,
  height = 9
) {

  fluc <- fluc_data_df
  cons <- cons_data_df

  fluc <- fluc[fluc[[generation_col]] %in% generations, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(fluc) == 0) {
    stop("No rows left in fluc_data_df after filtering generations.")
  }
  
  cons <- cons[cons[[cons_generation_col]] %in% cons_generations, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(cons) == 0) {
    stop("No rows left in cons_data_df after filtering cons_generations.")
  }

  # Keep only requested regs and psis
  fluc <- fluc[fluc$reg %in% regs & fluc$psi %in% psis, , drop = FALSE]
  cons <- cons[cons$reg %in% regs & cons$psi %in% psis, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(fluc) == 0) stop("No fluctuating data left after filtering regs/psis.")
  if (nrow(cons) == 0) stop("No constant data left after filtering regs/psis.")

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fluctuating data:
  # average across selected generations within each replicate
  # then average across reps for each reg × psi × shift_size × gap
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  fluc_rep_mean_df <- aggregate(
    fluc[[value_col]],
    by = list(
      reg = fluc$reg,
      psi = fluc$psi,
      shift_size = fluc$shift_size,
      gap = fluc$gap,
      rep = fluc[[rep_col]]
    ),
    FUN = mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  names(fluc_rep_mean_df)[names(fluc_rep_mean_df) == "x"] <- "fluc_rep_mean"

  fluc_mean_df <- aggregate(
    fluc_rep_mean ~ reg + psi + shift_size + gap,
    data = fluc_rep_mean_df,
    FUN = mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  names(fluc_mean_df)[names(fluc_mean_df) == "fluc_rep_mean"] <- "fluc_mean"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Constant data:
  # no gap column
  # average across selected generations within each replicate
  # then average across reps for each reg × psi × shift_size
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cons_rep_mean_df <- aggregate(
    cons[[value_col]],
    by = list(
      reg = cons$reg,
      psi = cons$psi,
      shift_size = cons$shift_size,
      rep = cons[[rep_col]]
    ),
    FUN = mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  names(cons_rep_mean_df)[names(cons_rep_mean_df) == "x"] <- "cons_rep_mean"

  cons_mean_df <- aggregate(
    cons_rep_mean ~ reg + psi + shift_size,
    data = cons_rep_mean_df,
    FUN = mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  names(cons_mean_df)[names(cons_mean_df) == "cons_rep_mean"] <- "cons_mean"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Keep only parameter combinations present in both datasets
  # Match by reg, psi, shift_size.
  # gap remains from fluc_data_df.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  plot_df <- merge(
    fluc_mean_df,
    cons_mean_df,
    by = c("reg", "psi", "shift_size"),
    all = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    stop("No shared reg × psi × shift_size combinations found between fluc_data_df and cons_data_df.")
  }

  plot_df$div_raw <- plot_df$fluc_mean / plot_df$cons_mean

  if (clip_negative) {
    plot_df$diff_plot <- pmax(plot_df$div_raw, 0)
  } else {
    plot_df$diff_plot <- plot_df$div_raw
  }

  shift_sizes <- sort(unique(plot_df$shift_size))
  gaps <- sort(unique(plot_df$gap))

  # Color scale
  if (is.null(zlim)) {
    if (clip_negative) {
      zmax <- max(plot_df$diff_plot, na.rm = TRUE)
      zlim <- c(0, zmax)
      cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(100)
    } else {
      max_abs <- max(abs(plot_df$diff_plot), na.rm = TRUE)
      zlim <- c(-max_abs, max_abs)
      cols <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
    }
  } else {
    if (clip_negative) {
      cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(100)
    } else {
      cols <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
    }
  }

  n_col <- length(cols)

  if (!is.null(file)) {
    pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
    on.exit(dev.off())
  }

  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)

  # Layout:
  # shared ylab | psi labels | 3 heatmap columns
  layout_mat <- rbind(
    c(1,  2,  3,  4,  5),
    c(1,  6,  7,  8,  9),
    c(1, 10, 11, 12, 13),
    c(0,  0, 14, 14, 14),
    c(0,  0, 15, 15, 15)
  )

  layout(
    layout_mat,
    widths  = c(0.10, 0.16, 1, 1, 1),
    heights = c(1, 1, 1, 0.16, 0.28)
  )

  # Shared vertical y-axis label
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  plot.new()
  text(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    labels = ylab,
    srt = 90,
    cex = 2.0
  )

  for (i_psi in seq_along(psis)) {
    psi_i <- psis[i_psi]

    # Psi row-label panel
    par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
    plot.new()
    text(
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.5,
      labels = bquote(psi == .(psi_i)),
      srt = 90,
      cex = 2.0
    )

    for (i_reg in seq_along(regs)) {
      reg_i <- regs[i_reg]

      sub <- plot_df[plot_df$psi == psi_i & plot_df$reg == reg_i, ]

      zmat <- matrix(
        NA_real_,
        nrow = length(shift_sizes),
        ncol = length(gaps),
        dimnames = list(as.character(shift_sizes), as.character(gaps))
      )

      text_mat <- matrix(
        NA_real_,
        nrow = length(shift_sizes),
        ncol = length(gaps),
        dimnames = list(as.character(shift_sizes), as.character(gaps))
      )

      for (k in seq_len(nrow(sub))) {
        shift_k <- as.character(sub$shift_size[k])
        gap_k <- as.character(sub$gap[k])

        zmat[shift_k, gap_k] <- sub$diff_plot[k]
        text_mat[shift_k, gap_k] <- sub$div_raw[k]
      }

      par(
        mar = c(
          ifelse(i_psi == length(psis), 2.8, 0.8),  # bottom
          ifelse(i_reg == 1, 3.0, 0.8),             # left
          ifelse(i_psi == 1, 3.8, 0.8),             # top
          0.8                                       # right
        )
      )

      image(
        x = seq_along(shift_sizes),
        y = seq_along(gaps),
        z = zmat,
        col = cols,
        zlim = zlim,
        xaxt = "n",
        yaxt = "n",
        xlab = "",
        ylab = ""
      )

      if (i_psi == length(psis)) {
        axis(
          side = 1,
          at = seq_along(shift_sizes),
          labels = shift_sizes,
          cex.axis = 0.8
        )
      }

      if (i_reg == 1) {
        axis(
          side = 2,
          at = seq_along(gaps),
          labels = gaps,
          las = 1,
          cex.axis = 0.8
        )
      }

      box()

      if (i_psi == 1) {
        title(
          main = ifelse(
            reg_i %in% names(reg_labels),
            reg_labels[[reg_i]],
            reg_i
          ),
          cex.main = 1.8
        )
      }

      if (add_text) {
        for (ii in seq_along(shift_sizes)) {
          for (jj in seq_along(gaps)) {
            val <- text_mat[ii, jj]

            if (!is.na(val)) {
              text(
                x = ii,
                y = jj,
                labels = round(val, text_digits),
                cex = 0.55
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # Shared x-axis label
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, xlab, cex = 2.0)

  # Horizontal color bar
  par(mar = c(2.6, 4, 0.4, 4))

  z_seq <- seq(zlim[1], zlim[2], length.out = n_col)

  image(
    x = z_seq,
    y = 1,
    z = matrix(z_seq, nrow = length(z_seq), ncol = 1),
    col = cols,
    zlim = zlim,
    xaxt = "n",
    yaxt = "n",
    xlab = "",
    ylab = ""
  )

  axis(1, cex.axis = 1.1)
  mtext(colorbar_label, side = 1, line = 1.8, cex = 1.1)

  invisible(list(
    plot_df = plot_df,
    fluc_rep_mean_df = fluc_rep_mean_df,
    cons_rep_mean_df = cons_rep_mean_df,
    fluc_mean_df = fluc_mean_df,
    cons_mean_df = cons_mean_df
  ))
}
```

```{r}
fit_decay_mean_traj <- function(df, xcol = "tick", ycol = "dif_z_opt",
                                tmin = 10000, tmax = 10100) {
  
  sub_df <- df[df[[xcol]] >= tmin & df[[xcol]] <= tmax, ]
  
  if (nrow(sub_df) == 0) {
    return(c(slope = NA, decay_const = NA, intercept = NA, r2 = NA))
  }
  
  # mean across reps for each generation
  mean_df <- aggregate(
    sub_df[[ycol]],
    by = list(tick = sub_df[[xcol]]),
    FUN = function(v) mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  colnames(mean_df)[2] <- ycol
  
  mean_df <- mean_df[is.finite(mean_df[[ycol]]) & mean_df[[ycol]] > 0, ]
  
  if (nrow(mean_df) < 5) {
    return(c(slope = NA, decay_const = NA, intercept = NA, r2 = NA))
  }
  
  fit <- lm(log(mean_df[[ycol]]) ~ mean_df$tick)
  
  slope <- coef(fit)[2]
  intercept <- coef(fit)[1]
  r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  
  c(
    slope,
     -slope,
    intercept,
    r2
  )
}

get_decay_summary_meantraj <- function(data_df,
                                       xcol = "tick",
                                       ycol = "dif_z_opt",
                                       tmin = 10000,
                                       tmax = 10100) {
  
  out_list <- list()
  idx <- 1
  
  for (reg in unique(data_df$reg)) {
    for (sz in sort(unique(data_df$shift_size))) {
      for (n in sort(unique(data_df$n))) {
        for (psi in sort(unique(data_df$psi))) {
          
          sub_df <- data_df[
            data_df$reg == reg &
            data_df$shift_size == sz &
            data_df$n == n &
            data_df$psi == psi,
          ]
          
          if (nrow(sub_df) == 0) next
          
          fit_res <- fit_decay_mean_traj(
            df = sub_df,
            xcol = xcol,
            ycol = ycol,
            tmin = tmin,
            tmax = tmax
          )
          
          out_list[[idx]] <- data.frame(
            reg = reg,
            shift_size = sz,
            n = n,
            psi = psi,
            slope = unname(fit_res[1]),
            decay_const = unname(fit_res[2]),
            intercept = unname(fit_res[3]),
            r2 = unname(fit_res[4])
          )
          
          idx <- idx + 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, out_list)
}
```

```{r}
compute_aurc_one <- function(
  df,
  filter,
  ycol,
  tick_pre = 9999,
  tmin = 10000,
  tmax = 10100
) {
  d <- df
  for (nm in names(filter)) {
    if (nm %in% names(d)) d <- d[d[[nm]] == filter[[nm]], , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NA_real_)

  # average across reps per tick
  avg <- aggregate(d[[ycol]], by = list(tick = d$tick), FUN = mean)
  names(avg) <- c("tick", "y")
  avg <- avg[order(avg$tick), , drop = FALSE]

  # baseline
  b <- avg$y[avg$tick == tick_pre]
  if (!length(b) || !is.finite(b[1])) return(NA_real_)
  W_pre <- b[1]

  # window
  w <- avg[avg$tick >= tmin & avg$tick <= tmax, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(w)) return(NA_real_)

  sum(W_pre - w$y, na.rm = TRUE)
}

compute_aurc_grid <- function(
  df,
  reg_value,
  ns,
  psis,
  shift_sizes,
  ycol,
  tick_pre = 9999,
  tmin = 10000,
  tmax = 10100
) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1

  for (sz in shift_sizes) {
    for (n in ns) {
      for (psi in psis) {
        filt <- list(reg = reg_value, shift_size = sz, n = n, psi = psi)
        aurc <- compute_aurc_one(
          df = df,
          filter = filt,
          ycol = ycol,
          tick_pre = tick_pre,
          tmin = tmin,
          tmax = tmax
        )
        out[[k]] <- data.frame(
          shift_size = sz,
          n = n,
          psi = psi,
          aurc = aurc,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

plot_aurc_heatmap_simple <- function(
  aurc_df,
  ns,
  psis,
  shift_size,
  zlim = NULL,
  main = NULL,
  palette = "RdYlBu",
  na_col = "grey90",
  ncols = 100,
  legend_title = "AURC"
) {
  ss <- aurc_df[aurc_df$shift_size == shift_size, , drop = FALSE]

  # matrix: rows = psi, cols = n
  mat <- matrix(NA_real_,
                nrow = length(psis),
                ncol = length(ns),
                dimnames = list(psis, ns))

  ii <- match(ss$psi, psis)
  jj <- match(ss$n, ns)
  ok <- !is.na(ii) & !is.na(jj)
  mat[cbind(ii[ok], jj[ok])] <- ss$aurc[ok]

  if (is.null(zlim)) {
    vals <- mat[is.finite(mat)]
    if (!length(vals)) stop("No finite AURC values for plotting.")
    zlim <- range(vals)
  }

  cols <- hcl.colors(ncols, palette, rev = TRUE)

  # ---- layout: plot + legend ----
  layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1), widths = c(1, 0.15))

  # ---- main heatmap ----
  par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 1))
  image(
    x = seq_along(ns),
    y = seq_along(psis),
    z = t(mat),
    col = cols,
    zlim = zlim,
    xaxt = "n",
    yaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Group size n",
    ylab = expression(psi),
    main = main
  )
  axis(1, at = seq_along(ns), labels = ns)
  axis(2, at = seq_along(psis), labels = psis, las = 1)
  box()

  # overlay NA tiles
  for (i in seq_along(psis)) {
    for (j in seq_along(ns)) {
      if (!is.finite(mat[i, j])) {
        rect(j - 0.5, i - 0.5, j + 0.5, i + 0.5,
             col = na_col, border = NA)
      }
    }
  }

  # ---- legend ----
  par(mar = c(5, 1, 4, 4))
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = zlim)

  yseq <- seq(zlim[1], zlim[2], length.out = ncols + 1)
  for (i in seq_len(ncols)) {
    rect(0.2, yseq[i], 0.8, yseq[i + 1],
         col = cols[i], border = NA)
  }

  axis(4, las = 1)
  mtext(legend_title, side = 4, line = 2)

  invisible(mat)
}
```

```{r}
fit_exp_decay_window <- function(
  df,
  filter,
  tmin = 10000,
  tmax = 10100,
  time_col = "tick",
  y_col = "z_opt",
  rep_col = "rep",
  model = c("offset", "no_offset"),
  nls_control = nls.control(maxiter = 500, warnOnly = TRUE)
) {
  model <- match.arg(model)

  # 1) filter
  sub <- df
  for (nm in names(filter)) sub <- sub[sub[[nm]] == filter[[nm]], , drop = FALSE]

  # 2) window
  sub <- sub[sub[[time_col]] >= tmin & sub[[time_col]] <= tmax, , drop = FALSE]
  sub <- sub[is.finite(sub[[time_col]]) & is.finite(sub[[y_col]]), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(sub) < 3) {
    return(list(converged = FALSE, message = "Not enough rows in window", params = NA, averaged = NULL, fit = NULL))
  }

  # 3) average reps per tick
  avg <- aggregate(sub[[y_col]], by = list(tick = sub[[time_col]]), FUN = mean)
  names(avg) <- c("tick", "z")
  avg <- avg[order(avg$tick), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(avg) < 3) {
    return(list(converged = FALSE, message = "Not enough unique ticks after averaging", params = NA, averaged = avg, fit = NULL))
  }

  # 4) re-center time at tmin for numerical stability
  avg$t <- avg$tick - tmin

  # 5) starting values (robust for your shape)
  c0 <- tail(avg$z, 1)
  a0 <- avg$z[1] - c0
  if (!is.finite(a0) || abs(a0) < 1e-8) a0 <- sign(a0 + 1e-8) * 1e-3

  # pick b0 from early-to-late change if possible
  tspan <- max(avg$t)
  b0 <- 1 / max(tspan, 1)
  st <- if (model == "offset") list(a = a0, b = abs(b0), c = c0) else list(a = avg$z[1], b = abs(b0))

  # 6) fit
  if (model == "offset") {
    form <- z ~ c + a * exp(-b * t)
    fit <- try(nls(form, data = avg, start = st, control = nls_control), silent = TRUE)
  } else {
    form <- z ~ a * exp(-b * t)
    fit <- try(nls(form, data = avg, start = st[c("a","b")], control = nls_control), silent = TRUE)
  }

  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    return(list(converged = FALSE, message = as.character(fit), params = NA, averaged = avg, fit = NULL))
  }

  list(
    converged = TRUE,
    message = NULL,
    params = coef(fit),   # a, b, (c)
    averaged = avg,
    fit = fit
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_first_jump_heatmap2 <- function(
  df,
  reg_value = "fit",
  ns,
  psis,
  shift_sizes,
  tick_pre = 9999,
  tick_post = 10000,
  time_col = "tick",
  rep_col = "rep",
  value_col = "z_mean",
  reg_col = "reg",
  n_col = "n",
  psi_col = "psi",
  shift_col = "shift_size",
  main_prefix = "First-generation jump (copy-the-best)",
  zlim = NULL,                    # recommend fixed across panels
  palette_name = "RdYlBu",
  ncols = 100,
  na_col = "grey90",
  file = NULL,
  width = 2200, height = 1800, res = 150
) {
  # --- filter to reg and two ticks ---
  sub <- df[df[[reg_col]] == reg_value &
              df[[time_col]] %in% c(tick_pre, tick_post), , drop = FALSE]

  needed <- c(time_col, rep_col, value_col, n_col, psi_col, shift_col)
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(sub))
  if (length(miss)) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  # --- per-rep jump ---
  wide <- reshape(
    sub[, c(rep_col, n_col, psi_col, shift_col, time_col, value_col)],
    idvar = c(rep_col, n_col, psi_col, shift_col),
    timevar = time_col,
    direction = "wide"
  )
  pre_name  <- paste0(value_col, ".", tick_pre)
  post_name <- paste0(value_col, ".", tick_post)
  if (!(pre_name %in% names(wide)) || !(post_name %in% names(wide))) {
    stop("Missing tick columns after reshape: ", pre_name, " / ", post_name)
  }
  wide$dz1 <- wide[[post_name]] - wide[[pre_name]]

  # --- average across replicates ---
  avg <- aggregate(
    wide$dz1,
    by = list(
      n = wide[[n_col]],
      psi = wide[[psi_col]],
      shift_size = wide[[shift_col]]
    ),
    FUN = mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  names(avg)[4] <- "dz1_mean"

  # --- build mats per shift_size ---
  build_mat <- function(sz) {
    ss <- avg[avg$shift_size == sz, , drop = FALSE]
    mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(psis), ncol = length(ns),
                  dimnames = list(psis, ns))
    ii <- match(ss$psi, psis)
    jj <- match(ss$n, ns)
    ok <- !is.na(ii) & !is.na(jj)
    mat[cbind(ii[ok], jj[ok])] <- ss$dz1_mean[ok]
    mat
  }
  mats <- lapply(shift_sizes, build_mat)
  names(mats) <- as.character(shift_sizes)

  # --- global zlim if not provided ---
  if (is.null(zlim)) {
    allv <- unlist(mats)
    zlim <- range(allv, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!all(is.finite(zlim))) zlim <- c(0, 1)
  }

  cols <- hcl.colors(ncols, palette_name, rev = TRUE)

  # map z -> color index
  z_to_col <- function(z) {
    if (!is.finite(z)) return(na_col)
    # clamp into zlim and convert to 1..ncols
    u <- (z - zlim[1]) / (zlim[2] - zlim[1])
    u <- max(0, min(1, u))
    cols[1 + floor(u * (ncols - 1))]
  }

  # draw a tile heatmap for one matrix
  draw_tiles <- function(mat, sz) {
    # layout coordinates: columns are ns, rows are psis
    # We'll plot x as 1..length(ns), y as 1..length(psis)
    plot(NA,
         xlim = c(0.5, length(ns) + 0.5),
         ylim = c(0.5, length(psis) + 0.5),
         xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n",
         xlab = "Group size n",
         ylab = expression(psi),
         main = paste0("shift_size = ", sz, "\n",
                       expression(Delta*z == z - z))
    )
    axis(1, at = seq_along(ns), labels = ns)
    axis(2, at = seq_along(psis), labels = psis, las = 1)

    for (j in seq_along(ns)) {
      for (i in seq_along(psis)) {
        rect(xleft = j - 0.5, xright = j + 0.5,
             ybottom = i - 0.5, ytop = i + 0.5,
             col = z_to_col(mat[i, j]),
             border = "white", lwd = 1)
      }
    }
    box()
  }

  # --- device ---
  if (!is.null(file)) {
    png(file, width = width, height = height, res = res)
    on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  }

  # --- multi-panel + one shared legend column ---
  k <- length(shift_sizes)
  # left panels + right legend column
  lay <- matrix(seq_len(k + 1), nrow = ceiling((k + 0) / 2), byrow = TRUE)
  # Force a 2-column panel grid, last column reserved for legend
  # Example for 4 sz: panels in 2x2, legend on right spanning rows
  layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 5,
                  3, 4, 5), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
         widths = c(1, 1, 0.18))

  op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(op), add = TRUE)

  par(mar = c(4.5, 5, 4, 1))
  draw_tiles(mats[[1]], shift_sizes[1])
  par(mar = c(4.5, 5, 4, 1))
  draw_tiles(mats[[2]], shift_sizes[2])
  par(mar = c(4.5, 5, 4, 1))
  draw_tiles(mats[[3]], shift_sizes[3])
  par(mar = c(4.5, 5, 4, 1))
  draw_tiles(mats[[4]], shift_sizes[4])

  # legend (shared)
  par(mar = c(4.5, 1, 4, 4))
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = zlim)
  # draw color bar
  yseq <- seq(zlim[1], zlim[2], length.out = ncols + 1)
  for (i in seq_len(ncols)) {
    rect(0.2, yseq[i], 0.8, yseq[i + 1], col = cols[i], border = NA)
  }
  axis(4, las = 1)
  mtext(expression(Delta*z), side = 4, line = 2)

  # page title
  mtext(main_prefix, side = 3, outer = TRUE, line = 1, cex = 1.3)

  invisible(list(avg = avg, mats = mats, zlim = zlim))
}
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SELF-CONTAINED PDF COMPILER (does NOT rely on plot_genotype_heatmap)
##
## Output:
##  - one PDF per shift_size
##  - 6 pages per PDF: (type ∈ {genotype, phenotype}) × (reg ∈ {ave, fit, ext})
##  - each page is a grid: rows = psi (0, 0.5, 0.9), cols = n (2, 8, 20, 50)
##  - one shared colorbar on the right for the whole page
##  - unified color scale per page (shared zlim across all panels on that page)
##
## Assumptions about your data:
##  - genotype is WIDE with numeric column names "0","1",... (or phenotype too, if wide)
##  - metadata columns include: generation, reg, psi, n, shift_size, fluctuate_gap
##  - If phenotype is long-format (single column), set pheno_value_col below.
## ============================================================

# -------------- helpers: filtering & genotype/phenotype extraction ----------
.value_cols_int <- function(df) grep("^[0-9]+$", names(df), value = TRUE)

.apply_filter <- function(df, filter) {
  d <- df
  for (nm in names(filter)) {
    if (!nm %in% names(d)) next
    val <- filter[[nm]]
    if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0) next
    d <- d[d[[nm]] == val, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  d
}

.reg_label <- function(reg) {
  if (reg == "fit") "copy the best" else
    if (reg == "ext") "copy the extreme" else
      if (reg == "ave") "copy the average" else reg
}

# -------------- build histogram matrix (bins × generations) -----------------
# Returns list(x=gens, y=mids, mat=bins×gens) where mat is proportion/count/density per generation.
.build_heatmat <- function(df, filter, xcol, breaks_vec,
                           mode = c("wide_numeric", "long_col"),
                           value_col = NULL,
                           z = c("prop", "count", "density")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  z <- match.arg(z)

  d <- .apply_filter(df, filter)
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  if (!xcol %in% names(d)) stop("Missing xcol: ", xcol)

  # generations present (gappy is fine)
  gens <- sort(unique(d[[xcol]]))
  x <- as.numeric(gens)

  # binning
  breaks <- breaks_vec
  mids <- (breaks[-1] + breaks[-length(breaks)]) / 2
  lo <- min(breaks)
  hi <- max(breaks)

  # identify value source
  if (mode == "wide_numeric") {
    vcols <- .value_cols_int(d)
    if (!length(vcols)) stop("No numeric-named columns found for wide_numeric mode.")
  } else {
    if (is.null(value_col) || !value_col %in% names(d)) {
      stop("long_col mode requires value_col present in df.")
    }
  }

  mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(mids), ncol = length(gens))

  for (j in seq_along(gens)) {
    g <- gens[j]
    dg <- d[d[[xcol]] == g, , drop = FALSE]

    vv <- if (mode == "wide_numeric") {
      as.numeric(unlist(dg[, vcols, drop = FALSE], use.names = FALSE))
    } else {
      as.numeric(dg[[value_col]])
    }
    vv <- vv[is.finite(vv)]
    vv <- vv[vv >= lo & vv <= hi]  # IMPORTANT: exclude outside range BEFORE hist

    h <- hist(vv, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)

    if (z == "count") {
      mat[, j] <- h$counts
    } else if (z == "prop") {
      s <- sum(h$counts)
      mat[, j] <- if (s > 0) h$counts / s else 0
    } else {
      mat[, j] <- h$density
    }
  }

  list(x = x, y = mids, mat = mat, gens = gens, breaks = breaks)
}

.plot_heat_panel <- function(hm, zlim, col, main = NULL, xlab = "", ylab = "",
                             axes = TRUE, box = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(hm)) {
    plot.new()
    if (!is.null(main)) title(main = main)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  x <- hm$x
  y <- hm$y
  mat <- hm$mat

  # ---- make zeros NA ----
  mat_plot <- mat
  mat_plot[mat_plot == 0] <- NA

  # ---- save old background ----
  old_bg <- par("bg")
  par(bg = "black")

  plot(NA,
       xlim = range(x), ylim = range(y),
       xlab = xlab, ylab = ylab, main = main,
       xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i", axes = FALSE)

  image(x, y, t(mat_plot), col = col, zlim = zlim, add = TRUE)

  if (axes) { axis(1); axis(2) }
  if (box) box()

  # ---- restore background ----
  par(bg = old_bg)

  invisible(NULL)
}


# -------------- draw a shared colorbar in its own layout cell ---------------
.draw_colorbar_panel <- function(zlim, col, label = "Proportion", n = 120) {
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = zlim)

  yy <- seq(zlim[1], zlim[2], length.out = n + 1)
  cols <- if (length(col) == n) col else colorRampPalette(col)(n)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    rect(0.25, yy[i], 0.60, yy[i + 1], col = cols[i], border = NA)
  }
  rect(0.25, zlim[1], 0.60, zlim[2], border = "black")

  axis(4, at = pretty(zlim, 5), las = 1)
  mtext(label, side = 4, line = 2)
}
```

## plot the allele frequency heatmaps for one shift_size, with one page per reg (ave/fit/ext)
```{r}
.apply_filter <- function(df, filter) {
  d <- df
  for (nm in names(filter)) {
    if (!nm %in% names(d)) next
    val <- filter[[nm]]
    if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0) next
    d <- d[d[[nm]] == val, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  d
}
.build_effect_heatmat <- function(df, filter, xcol = "gen",
                                  breaks_vec,
                                  y = c("signed", "abs"),
                                  z = c("prop", "count", "density", "mean_freq"),
                                  only_segregating = TRUE,
                                  new_only = FALSE,
                                  new_window = 0) {
  y <- match.arg(y)
  z <- match.arg(z)

  d <- .apply_filter(df, filter)
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  if (!xcol %in% names(d)) stop("Missing xcol: ", xcol)
  if (!"effect_size" %in% names(d)) stop("Missing effect_size column")
  if (!"frequencies" %in% names(d)) stop("mean_freq requires frequencies column")

  if (only_segregating) {
    d <- d[d$frequencies > 0 & d$frequencies < 1, , drop=FALSE]
    if ("isFixed" %in% names(d)) d <- d[!d$isFixed, , drop=FALSE]
  }

  if (new_only) {
    if (!"originTick" %in% names(d)) stop("new_only requires originTick column")
    d <- d[(d$originTick >= (d[[xcol]] - new_window)) & (d$originTick <= d[[xcol]]), , drop=FALSE]
  }

  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)

  gens <- sort(unique(d[[xcol]]))
  x <- as.numeric(gens)

  breaks <- breaks_vec
  mids <- (breaks[-1] + breaks[-length(breaks)]) / 2
  lo <- min(breaks); hi <- max(breaks)

  mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(mids), ncol = length(gens))

  for (j in seq_along(gens)) {
    g <- gens[j]
    dg <- d[d[[xcol]] == g, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(dg)) next

    vv <- as.numeric(dg$effect_size)
    pp <- as.numeric(dg$frequencies)

    keep <- is.finite(vv) & is.finite(pp)
    vv <- vv[keep]; pp <- pp[keep]
    if (y == "abs") vv <- abs(vv)

    # restrict to plotting range
    keep2 <- (vv >= lo & vv <= hi)
    vv <- vv[keep2]; pp <- pp[keep2]
    if (!length(vv)) next

    # bin assignment for effect sizes
    b <- cut(vv, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)
    # mean frequency per bin
    mean_by_bin <- tapply(pp, b, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

    # fill column j; align bin levels
    mat[, j] <- 0  # bins with no mutations => 0 mean frequency (choose NA if you prefer)
    idx_bins <- match(levels(b), names(mean_by_bin))
    mat[idx_bins[!is.na(idx_bins)], j] <- mean_by_bin[na.omit(idx_bins)]
  }

  # replace NA with 0 for plotting if any remain
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

  list(x = x, y = mids, mat = mat, gens = gens, breaks = breaks)
}

.plot_allele_heat_panel <- function(hm, zlim, col, main = NULL, xlab = "", ylab = "",
                             axes = TRUE, box = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(hm)) {
    plot.new()
    if (!is.null(main)) title(main = main)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  x <- hm$x
  y <- hm$y
  mat <- hm$mat

  plot(NA,
       xlim = range(x), ylim = range(y),
       xlab = xlab, ylab = ylab, main = main,
       xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i", axes = FALSE)

  image(x, y, t(mat), col = col, zlim = zlim, add = TRUE)

  if (axes) { axis(1); axis(2) }
  if (box) box()
  invisible(NULL)
}

.draw_colorbar_panel <- function(zlim, col, label = "Proportion", n = 120) {
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = zlim)

  yy <- seq(zlim[1], zlim[2], length.out = n + 1)

  }

  axis(4, at = pretty(zlim, 5), las = 1)
  mtext(label, side = 4, line = 2)
}
```

```{r}
.delta_p_panel_data <- function(df, filter, t_before = 10000, t_after = 10010,
                                xcol = "gen") {
  d <- df
  # apply filter list (reg/n/psi/shift_size; DO NOT include gen)
  for (nm in names(filter)) {
    if (!nm %in% names(d)) next
    d <- d[d[[nm]] == filter[[nm]], , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)

  # keep segregating only (optional; comment out if you want all)
  if ("frequencies" %in% names(d)) d <- d[d$frequencies > 0 & d$frequencies < 1, , drop=FALSE]
  if ("isFixed" %in% names(d))     d <- d[!d$isFixed, , drop=FALSE]

  # split before/after
  d0 <- d[d[[xcol]] == t_before, c("id","rep","effect_size","frequencies"), drop=FALSE]
  d1 <- d[d[[xcol]] == t_after,  c("id","rep","effect_size","frequencies"), drop=FALSE]
  if (!nrow(d0) || !nrow(d1)) return(NULL)

  names(d0)[names(d0)=="frequencies"] <- "p0"
  names(d1)[names(d1)=="frequencies"] <- "p1"
  names(d0)[names(d0)=="effect_size"] <- "a0"
  names(d1)[names(d1)=="effect_size"] <- "a1"

  # merge by (rep, id) so we compare same allele within same replicate
  m <- merge(d0, d1, by = c("rep","id"), all = FALSE)
  if (!nrow(m)) return(NULL)

  # effect size should be constant; take a0 (or average)
  m$effect <- m$a0
  m$delta_p <- m$p1 - m$p0
  m$delta_p_percentage <- ifelse(m$p0 > 0, m$delta_p / m$p0 * 100, NA_real_)

  m
}

.fit_line_info <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  if (length(x) < 3) return(list(b0=NA_real_, b1=NA_real_))

  fit <- lm(y ~ x)
  co <- coef(fit)  # (Intercept), x
  list(b0 = unname(co[1]), b1 = unname(co[2]))
}
```
